claims.claim: The project builds an isolated, pinned Open5GS and UERANSIM container baseline with scoped lifecycle controls.
claims.scope_limit: Validated on the documented Linux/AMD64 Ubuntu host; no multi-platform or production registry claim is made.

claims.claim: The kind and Helm deployment completes registration, PDU session establishment, and bidirectional user-plane validation.
claims.scope_limit: One local kind node, one gNB, one UPF, and synthetic subscribers; this is not a carrier production topology.

claims.claim: Five concurrent synthetic UEs use unique sessions across internet and enterprise DNNs with cross-DNN isolation.
claims.scope_limit: Exactly five UEs and two DNN contracts were accepted; general scale and slice isolation are not claimed.

claims.claim: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alloy, and kube-state-metrics provide bounded metrics, logs, dashboards, and exercised alerts.
claims.scope_limit: Single-node, single-replica local observability with no external alert delivery or high-availability claim.

claims.claim: A controlled 1/3/5-UE matrix produced reviewed throughput, procedure, and resource evidence through the UE tunnel.
claims.scope_limit: Local experimental results are not capacity, radio performance, or production service-level objectives.

claims.claim: Controlled AMF, SMF, and UPF failures produced reviewed detection, restoration, and user-plane disruption evidence.
claims.scope_limit: Single-replica operator-assisted recovery is measured; high availability and automatic failover are not claimed.

claims.claim: Hosted deterministic checks and local privileged validation cover policy, secrets, image vulnerabilities, SBOMs, and live regressions.
claims.scope_limit: The hosted runner is deliberately unprivileged; real 5G and host-network checks remain a separate local gate.
